content.text:
**Final finding submitted: deviation on §§ 21.1 and 21.3 (LOL-CAP), preferred level.**

1. **§ 21.1** — re-based to "Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000", replacing the one-month "without exception" cap so the § 21.3 Excluded Claims operate as true super-cap items.
2. **§ 21.3 final sentence** — payment carve-out now covers "undisputed amounts due under this Agreement" rather than only "undisputed Fees for conforming Services", curing the defined-"Fees" gap (taxes, expenses, interest, implementation charge) while retaining the Customer-favourable "undisputed" qualifier per the verifier's drafting note.

Mutuality of the cap and § 21.2's mutual indirect/consequential exclusion (with its Customer-favourable direct-damages sentence) remain already met and untouched; no ancillary terms were added.
